analysis.reasonEn: RSI exited oversold territory from 42.3 to 53.4. MACD histogram improved from -0.9225 to 0.9173, signaling an upward turn. The 5-day low of $81.79 is higher than the 20-day low of $77.45, forming a Higher Low pattern. Weekly RSI at 57.3 maintains an uptrend. 4-hour RSI at 59.4 continues the upward momentum. While the 5-day average volume ratio is slightly subdued at 0.79, the overall upward signals from indicators prevail.
